MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 41
   C. 49
   D. 31

3. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

4. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

6. Solve for x: x + 9 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 9
   C. 6
   D. 5

7. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 21

8. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 170

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 5² = 5 × 5
3. 5² = 25
Final Answer: 25
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

Working:
